From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP: success ledger + operational test roster

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for carving out time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass MAP and an operational test roster to make the acceptance conversation concrete (MAP_Redline_20260806.xlsx attached as a placeholder). Before we lock dates with your team, can you confirm owners and whether the baseline targets below look achievable from VeraCore's side? I tried to split acceptance into business KPIs and technical verification so signoff is clear.

Business success criteria (owner / acceptance signal):
- Reduction in triage time: 25% median decrease (owner: Samir) — validated by baseline vs week-4 production metrics.
- Accuracy threshold on the escalation classifier: ≥ 88% precision on the validation set (owner: Elena).
- Stakeholder satisfaction: Product team approves with an NPS-style quick survey (owner: VeraCore PM).

Technical exit gates (owner / acceptance test):
- P95 inference latency ≤ 300 ms under target load (20 concurrent users / typical seq length) — test harness: smoke-harness.sh (owner: Priyom).
- Throughput stability: sustained 2 tokens/ms average across 30-minute soak at expected concurrency (owner: Priyom).
- KV/cache correctness: zero-state drift on 48-hour regression (owner: Ben).
- Data handling & residency: logs and audit snapshots retained for 90 days in US region (owner: Samir).

Acceptance runbook highlights (see attached eval-test-cases.docx):
- Day 0: Integration sanity + smoke tests (automated).
- Day 1–3: Canary at 10% traffic; collect metrics and edge-case errors.
- Go/no-go: After 72-hour canary with no critical regressions and signoff from VeraCore PM + Redwood Security.

Ask: Please reply with any adjustments to owners/targets and attach any required compliance evidence or additional gating constraints. If all good, Samir + Elena, can we target the week of 8/24 for canary?

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: MAP_Redline_20260806.xlsx (draft), eval-test-cases.docx (summary of verification scripts), evidence-guidance.pdf (what counts as evidence)

Marissa —

Appreciate the crisp breakdown. Overall this is helpful. A few immediate notes after reviewing the MAP draft and running it past our infra lead:

1) Latency: Our current integration (internal transformation layer) adds ~100–150 ms P95. Can we make the latency gate P95 ≤ 450 ms for the initial canary and then revisit for production optimization? If Redwood can show <300 ms in a direct integration test we’re comfortable with a staged target.

2) Data residency: VeraCore requires evidence of access logs and encryption-in-transit keys for the first signoff. I attached a redline to the MAP with that requirement flagged (MAP_Redline_20260806.xlsx).

3) Test owners: Samir will own business metric collection; I’ll be the acceptance approver. Priyom owning shard-level tests works for us. Proposed canary week: 8/24–8/28. Our PM wants to keep the canary to 2 business days initially and extend to 72 hours if we see stability.

We’ll also need a brief pre-canary runbook walkthrough with Priyom and Ben to confirm tooling and alert rules. Can Priyom propose 60-minute block next week?

Thanks —
Elena
Head of Integrations
VeraCore Health

Thanks Elena — quick note from the engineering side with a proposed minimal verification matrix so the canary is deterministic and repeatable. I’ve attached eval-test-cases.docx and a tiny harness script (smoke-harness.sh) we’ll run from our infra lab.

Proposed technical check list (automation-first):
- Integration smoke (5m): connectivity, auth, schema validation (script: smoke-harness.sh) — pass if no 5xx and schema diff < 1%.
- Latency benchmark (10m ramp): synthetic traffic using VeraCore sample payloads; measure P50/P95/P99. For canary we’ll consider P95 ≤ 450 ms as Elena suggested; production target will be P95 ≤ 300 ms once transformation layer optimizations are complete.
- Regression suite (30m): 120 archived prompts covering edge categories (mislabel risk, hallucination triggers). Acceptance: precision ≥ 88% and no critical false positives across priority set.
- Soak/throughput test (30m): verify token/sec and OOM events. Acceptance: 0 OOMs, steady token throughput within ±8% of baseline.

Operational runbook excerpt (for signoff):
- Owner alignment call (Day -3): Priyom, Ben, VeraCore infra, VeraCore PM.
- Canary start (Day 0): enable 10% traffic split; run smoke + latency benchmarks in first 3 hours.
- Mid-canary review (Day 1): collect metrics and open findings doc; triage critical items within SLA window (4 hours).
- Decision window (Day 2 or 3 depending on VeraCore preference): If metrics meet gates and no unresolved criticals, VeraCore PM + Redwood Security sign off; otherwise, rollback to baseline and schedule remediation sprint.

I propose a 60-minute runbook walkthrough on Tue 8/11 at 10:00 AM PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the harness run instructions and example metric dashboards.

—Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Elena / Samir —

Thanks for the quick iterations and the redline. Summary of agreed gates and operational commitments below so we have a single source of truth before canary week (8/24). I’ll attach the final MAP to the HubSpot deal and kick off the DocuSign for the narrow addendum (evidence & residency confirmation).

Final acceptance gates (agreed):
- Canary acceptance: P95 ≤ 450 ms (canary), precision ≥ 88% on priority validation set, no critical regressions, and evidence of access logs + TLS key proof (security).
- Production target: P95 ≤ 300 ms within the next optimization sprint (observable goal, not a hard blocker for initial deploy).
- Signoff owners: VeraCore PM (final approver), Redwood Security (evidence reviewer), Marissa (customer success), Priyom (tech owner).

Runbook & cadence:
- 8/11 10:00 AM PT: 60-min runbook walkthrough (Priyom to send invite) — required.
- 8/24: Canary start (10% traffic).
- 8/25: Mid-canary checkpoint and metrics review.
- 8/26–8/27: Extend to 72 hours if metrics require; decision no later than 8/27 EOD PT.

Artifacts we’ll collect during canary (what counts as evidence):
- Per-request latency histograms and p95 snapshots (sampled logs).
- Confusion matrix and sample outputs for any false positives (stored in evidence bucket).
- Audit trail for config changes and access logs for 90 days.

Next steps:
- Priyom: send runbook invite + harness README (Action: Tue 8/11 10:00 AM PT).
- Samir/Elena: confirm receipt of DocuSign addendum and initial owner list (Action: sign by 8/18).
- Ben: prepare alert runbook and Slack escalation channel.

If that all matches your understanding, I’ll update the HubSpot MAP and share final links. Thanks everyone — pleased to have this tight plan.

Best,
Marissa Cole
